business_problem: Milliman wants to empower its clients to understand the risks facing their business more quickly and how to best mitigate those risks. Milliman's journey with Microsoft Fabric began during the private preview, allowing Milliman to take a considered, step-by-step approach to deployment.
solution_summary: Milliman wants to empower its clients to understand the risks facing their business more quickly and how to best mitigate those risks. Milliman's journey with Microsoft Fabric began during the private preview, allowing Milliman to take a considered, step-by-step approach to deployment. "Microsoft Fabric would have been our choice from the beginning-had it only existed then. Building a democratized data platform was too big of a distraction from our focus on supporting actuaries in managing risk." Tom Peplow, Principal and Senior Director of Technology Strategy for Life Technology Solutions, Milliman Insurance companies constantly undertake and mitigate risks, so that even in a downturn or disaster, they remain solvent. Any calamity has the potential to dramatically change the economic equation of an insurer. Actuaries are the experts who use probability, mathematics-and large amounts of data-to understand, predict, and forecast risk.

solution_components.name: Azure Data Factory
solution_components.role: Orchestrates and ingests data pipelines from operational source systems into the analytics platform.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Fabric
solution_components.role: Provides the shared data platform for storing, governing, and analyzing enterprise data across teams.

solution_components.name: Power BI
solution_components.role: Publishes dashboards and reports so teams can monitor operations and act on live insights.

solution_components.name: GitHub
solution_components.role: Provides the collaboration and code-hosting platform used in the customer's engineering workflow.

data_flow: Operational data is ingested through Azure Data Factory processed in Microsoft Fabric and published to teams through Power BI dashboards.
